summary: Virtual Try-On (AI) feature verified end-to-end — backend and frontend. All 6 pytest cases pass including real Gemini Nano Banana generation; full UI flow (home teaser -> shop -> product -> try-on -> upload -> generate -> result -> compare -> share -> close) works. No deprecated Expo packages or React Native issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: render_service.py:161 generate_tryon raises RuntimeError when product image is unreachable; create_tryon maps unknown exceptions to a generic 502. If a product in the DB has image=null, user will get an opaque 502 — consider validating product['image'] up front and returning a clearer 400/422.
try-on/[id].tsx:205 StyleSheetFill is a plain object literal (not StyleSheet.create). Works, but is slightly inconsistent with the StyleSheet.create pattern used elsewhere.
server.py:14 duplicate import block for FastAPI File/Form/UploadFile — purely cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused 117 synced Shopify products from gadojewellers.com and /tmp/hand.jpg sample photo.
